column1: # Commit map of the history rewrite of 1 October 2026
# The commit messages of this repository were rewritten once, to remove a tool-attribution
# trailer that 78 of them carried. Nothing else changed: every commit keeps its tree, its
# author, its committer and both dates, and the file contents of every revision are the ones
# that were there before. Only the messages, and therefore the commit hashes, differ.
# Stored records cite the commit at which a run or an analysis was made. Those records were
# not edited, because they are observations. This map resolves the hashes they cite.
